body.name: UnicycleHandle
body.def: Identify the weak full-graph components of \(X\) and \(Y\); return a component cut if they differ; on a common rank-zero component, return a directed-reachability cut unless \(X\) reaches \(Y\), and only then run the value-path compiler; on a common rank-one component run the exceptional-edge min-sum program; retain every other component at actuality.
